findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 2043 requests to 186 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 4.6 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.3 MB (72%) came from third-party domains, 2.3 MB of it from services classified as tracking (1431 requests).

93 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising).
546 cookies were set by third-party domains (580 cookies in total).
